translation: Took place in posad Serock, 4 April 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Alter Blumberg, trader, 22, of Serock, and Icek Wajnkraf[?], trader, 28, of Popowo-Koscielne, and declared that yesterday at 3 AM in the village of Janki[?] died Chaja Sura Fogelman, daughter of Iser and Ruchla nee Berman, aged 10 years. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Fogelman, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
